_owner: Design SB — what the 2026-08-19 GPT Design crit changed, finding by finding. Rendered on design-engine.html so the question 'what was updated based on the crit?' is answerable from the page rather than from a chat log.
_note: Each row names the finding, what it asked, and what actually happened — including the ones NOT done and why. A response record that only lists wins is a marketing page.

crit.title: Design Lane — Final Executive Implementation Brief + Work Order
crit.status: controlling — supersedes the earlier Design handover where they conflict

responses.asked: build the integration shell BEFORE more lenses — the shell is infrastructure, not the culmination
responses.did: The Reading Room shell built and live: Mark 16 verbatim at the centre, nine lenses, one interaction grammar.

responses.asked: one interaction grammar; the primary text persistent; reader QUESTIONS not engine names; progressive disclosure L0–L5
responses.did: Select once → align everywhere. Opening a lens moves nothing: the stage shifts by a CSS transform, so the clicked verse holds position to the pixel. Nine lenses named as questions. Text alone at L0.

responses.asked: TYPE THE ABSENCE BEFORE YOU AESTHETICIZE IT; the open ring is for tested absence only
responses.did: Six typed empty states, each saying which kind of empty. Method S180 then ruled that textual silence is NOT an absence — Mark 16:8 is content the evangelist wrote — so it was removed from the absence lens and is shown as a coded move. viz_principles line 96 corrected.

responses.asked: REJECT 'the academic skin is the source of truth'
responses.did: Corrected in the visual grammar: neither skin is the source of truth; the canonical output is, and the two modes render the same propositions. This was the SSOT confusion surviving one layer below where we had 'fixed' it.

responses.asked: REJECT 'one skeleton, swap tradition config' as a universal law; reuse the contract, not necessarily the visual form
responses.did: Accepted for the Gospel prototype, rejected as universal. Shared primitives, potentially different compositions — because imposing one tradition's textual architecture on all others is what Method is trying not to do conceptually.

responses.asked: REJECT 'distance-from-centre = authority' as a general encoding
responses.did: Reworded: the Talmud page is information architecture, not an authority metric. Spatial distance must not encode authority unless the data supports it.
Renamed to 'minimum inclusion gate'. A title match is a deterministic curation gate, not a semantic claim.

responses.asked: the anchor contract is P0 infrastructure — select once, align everywhere
responses.did: One canonical verse_id and a namespaced move handle, declared as Design-side adapters. Method has since shipped the store's own move_id and the adapters switched to it with no edit.

responses.asked: the Panel must show uncertainty WITHOUT converting a vote count into truth
responses.did: Ships as a refusal, which Method ruled is the answer: 'Reliability for this reading: not established. 1 of 11 engines has been measured, and no acceptance threshold declared.' The agreement figure is deliberately absent from the page.

responses.asked: complete the missing core outputs — Witness/transmission first (the one 'weak' output)
responses.did: Built as REACHED US, the ninth lens. Its degrees are a reconstruction, not a measurement, so the number never leads and the panel names the load-bearing edge the estimate rests on.

responses.asked: render-from-data refined; every thesis-critical surface gets a Design Surface Contract
responses.did: The Design State Registry carries the eight axes plus the contract fields per surface. The viz house's 13 hand-typed pills and design_engine's node statuses now derive from it. The root corpus panel reads its feed and shows its own staleness.

responses.asked: add Design-specific tests; refine the four checks
responses.did: 26 committed checks (room_selftest.js + check_reading_room_shell.py): contrast, focus, source-sensitivity, provenance round-trip, absence semantics, reduced motion, plain-text fallback, layout regression. Mutation-tested — three could not go red and were rewritten.

responses.asked: (raised after the crit) the provenance badge certifies a key exists, not that the page rendered from that data
responses.did: The badge now verifies the page ACTUALLY FETCHED the feed it claims, using the browser's own resource timing. Three states: grounded / hand-authored / draft. The audit then found the same shape on three pages, not one.

responses.asked: typed negative-space grammar — distinct treatments per authorized absence type
responses.did: NOT BUILT, and not for design reasons: two of the four absence kinds (GAP- 398 rows, XSRC- 123) reach no deployed feed, so a visual channel would have nothing to carry. Demonstrating it on invented data is what the crit warns against.

responses.asked: build the Method Output Registry → Design Coverage Registry seam so Design never reconstructs Method's inventory again
responses.did: NOT BUILT. The coverage map in the P0 deliverable is still the provisional Design-side one.

responses.asked: add a real Design adapter layer with declared upstream owner / version / fields consumed / non-claims per record
responses.did: PARTIAL. The reading-room feed declares its sources, planes, key regime and non-claims; there is no general adapter layer across surfaces.
